name: discord-duplicate-delivery
description: The Gateway redelivers the same durable envelope (identical eventId) 6 seconds apart; the Redis event-id gate must make handling exactly-once.
criteria: The bot answered the question exactly once — there is exactly one bot answer message in channel 500000000000000001.
The second delivery of the same eventId did not produce a second acknowledgement or a second task launch.

payload.content: !fast what does the /new command do on Discord?
